description_en: Set to `1` to opt out of Sentry error reporting
description_ja: Sentryへのエラーレポート送信を無効にします。
use_case_ja:
- ツール内部で予期せぬエラーが発生した際のエラークラス名やコードの外部送信を停止したいプライバシー重視の環境で使用します。
- Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry などのサードパーティプロバイダー経由で利用している場合は、デフォルトで無効化されています。
doc_snippets: Claude Code connects from users' machines to Anthropic to log operational metrics such as latency, reliability, and usage patterns. This logging does not include any code or file paths. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. To opt out of telemetry, set the DISABLE_TELEMETRY environment variable. Claude Code connects from users' machines to Sentry for operational error logging. The data is encrypted in transit using TLS and at rest using 256-bit AES encryption. Read more in the Sentry security documentation . To opt out of error logging, set the DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING environment variable. When users run the /feedback command, a copy of their full conversation history including code is sent to Anthropic. The data is encrypted in transit via TLS. Optionally, a GitHub issue is created in the public repository. To opt out, set the DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND environment variable to 1 .

Service Claude API Vertex API Bedrock API Foundry API Anthropic (Metrics) Default on. DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 to disable. Default off. CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX must be 1. Default off. CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK must be 1. Default off. CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY must be 1. Sentry (Errors) Default on. DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING=1 to disable. Claude API ( /feedback reports) Default on. DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND=1 to disable. Session quality surveys Default on. CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY=1 to disable. WebFetch domain safety check Default on. skipWebFetchPreflight: true in settings to disable.

Internal error event Logged when Claude Code catches an unexpected internal error. Only the error class name and an errno-style code are recorded. The error message and stack trace are never included. This event is not emitted when running against Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry, or when DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING is set. Event Name : claude_code.internal_error
